title: fix(spec): the /packages list-door tombstone enumerates all three filters that door reads (#19407)
body:
Fixes #19407

Clause-②: yes

## The defect, and the one thing that moves

`limit` and `cursor` on `ListInstalledPackagesRequestSchema` are `retiredKey()` tombstones
that both raise `PACKAGES_LIST_PAGINATION_REMOVED`. That prescription enumerated the serving
door's filters as `status` / `type`. The door reads a **third**, `enabled`.

⭐ **Measured from the serving code, not from the card.** `handlePackagesRequest`'s
`parts.length === 0 && m === 'GET'` branch, `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` on
`origin/main` at `1f69917c5c`, reads exactly three query keys and no others:

| key | read point | effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `readEnabledFilter(query?.enabled)` (:828), applied at :845 | `packageCountsAsEnabled(p) === enabled.value` |
| `status` | `if (query?.status)` (:837) | `p.status === query.status` |
| `type` | `if (query?.type)` (:840) | `p.manifest?.type === query.type` |

No `limit`, no `cursor`, no fourth key. The card's framing holds: the enumeration named two
of three. The `enabled` leg is PR #19405's; it is merged, so the premise is live and settled.

## Incomplete, ⛔ not falsified — and the diff is shaped by that

The sentence's load-bearing claim — *no page was ever withheld and no continuation token was
ever minted*, the argument for why `limit` / `cursor` were removable at all — **stays true**,
because `enabled` filters rows and does not paginate. Nor did the sentence ever assert that
`enabled` was unavailable: it enumerated, it did not exclude.

⇒ **only the enumeration moves.** The removability argument, the `.default(50)` passage, the
`hasMore` passage and the closing cursor-design sentence are **byte-identical**. Proven by
reassembling the concatenated literal before and after: the whole 986 → 1009 character string
differs in exactly two places.

```
FROM  … the serving door filters on `status` / `type` and then returns every remaining row …
      … Filter with `status` and `type` instead of asking for a window.

TO    … the serving door filters on `status` / `type` / `enabled` and then returns every
        remaining row …
      … Filter with `status`, `type` and `enabled` instead of asking for a window.
```

## Every carrier of the sentence, and which one changed

A sibling card exists because a near-identical sentence shipped in two entries and only one
was repaired, so the sweep is recorded in full. Multiline regex sweep over every tracked file,
five spellings, at `1f69917c5c`:

| carrier | kind | changed here |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `packages/spec/src/api/package-api.zod.ts` — `PACKAGES_LIST_PAGINATION_REMOVED` | source of the raised string | ✅ yes |
| `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.packages-list-pagination-retired.ts` — `replacement` and `reason` | ADR-0087 D3 entry | ✅ yes |
| `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/retired-keys/18.api__ListInstalledPackagesRequest__limit.ts` | record comment | ✅ yes |
| `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` (3 sites) | GENERATED mirror of the two above | ✅ regenerated, ⛔ never hand-edited |
| `content/docs/references/api/package-api.mdx` (2 rows) | GENERATED from the spec | ✅ regenerated |
| `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts:873` | comment | already correct — #19405 wrote it as `status` / `type` / `enabled` |
| `docs/protocol-upgrade-guide.md`, `packages/spec/spec-changes.json` | generated | do **not** carry the sentence; `check:upgrade-guide` and `check:spec-changes` both exit 0 |
| `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` | published | do **not** carry it — spec is at 17.4.0 and the tombstone names the unreleased 17.5.0, so nothing has shipped yet |
| `.changeset/17667-packages-query-contract.md:14` | unreleased changeset | ⛔ **not changed** — outside this card's declared file surface. See acceptance notes. |
| `.changeset/scoped-packages-dispatcher-door.md:13` | unreleased changeset | ⛔ **not changed** — same reason. |

After this PR, zero carriers of the old enumeration remain under `packages/` or `content/`;
the only two left in the tree are the two `.changeset/` entries above.

## One bounded in-place repair, declared

`packages/spec/src/api/package-api.zod.ts` also carried a paragraph on
`ListInstalledPackagesRequestSchema` reading **「`enabled` is still declared here and still
unread by that door … the symmetry above is TRUE of `status` / `type` / `limit` / `cursor`
and PENDING for `enabled`」**. That is **falsified** — not merely incomplete — by the same
runtime change, and it sat forty lines from the tombstone this PR repairs, so shipping one
without the other would land a self-contradicting file.

It is inside this card's declared file surface, it is the same defect class from the same
cause, no other in-flight branch holds the file, and it discharges on the condition the
paragraph itself names (「The same ruling closes it (item 2 …) in the runtime, which is a
different file and a different PR」). It is flipped to a closed record, keeping its guardrail
against deleting `enabled`. Reviewers who want it split out: say so and it comes out.

## Pinning

⛔ No new pin. The repo's rule is that prescription prose is not pinned unless a consumer
parses its exact text, and none does. The existing pin
(`packages/spec/src/api/package-api.test.ts:88`) anchors the message's stable prefix
(`` `limit` / `cursor` were removed from GET /api/v1/packages ``), not the enumeration, so it
holds unchanged — and it still proves the tombstone is raised rather than a bare
unrecognized-key issue. A mechanical pin tying the enumeration to the door's real read set
would have to reach across packages into the runtime, which is a new verification surface and
its own card.

## Verification — measured at `a755473aac`

Gates the card named explicitly:

```
pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:migration-registry   :: exit 0
pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:spec-changes         :: exit 0
pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:upgrade-guide        :: exit 0
node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --self-test       :: exit 0
node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main :: exit 0
```

Derived family, `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` over this branch's own change set
(⛔ not a hand-written list), reconciled with `--ran`:

```
104 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 103 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN
```

The one NOT MEASURED is `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, **exit 3 — PREREQUISITE NOT MET**,
not a finding: it reads built output for the whole monorepo (26 packages with no `dist`). That
is a repo-level scan CI owns. Everything else exits 0, including
`check:generated` (all 15 artifacts current), `check:docs`, `check:api-surface`,
`check:authorable-surface` and `check:nul-bytes`.

Tests and types for the affected package — the public surface is byte-unchanged
(`check:api-surface` exit 0), so no importer owes a run:

```
pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test       :: 509 test files, 14895 tests passed, 1 todo
pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck  :: exit 0
```

Lint is a **proven narrowing**, not a skipped gate. eslint over the six changed files:
exit 0, 0 errors. ① Population read from eslint's own config, not guessed — the `.md` and
`.mdx` files report *File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied*, so four of
six are in the lint population. ② Count read from `--format json`: 6 entries, 4 linted,
0 errors. ③ Invariance, quoted from `eslint.config.mjs`: *this repo runs one
`eslint.config.mjs`, which never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no
typed `@typescript-eslint` rules) for ANY file, test or not* ⇒ this diff cannot move the
verdict on any file it does not touch. CI still runs the full sweep.

Changeset: `patch`, and the publication was **measured, not assumed** — the new enumeration is
present in four files under the package's declared `files[]` (`dist/api/index.js`,
`dist/browser/api/index.{js,mjs}`) and in `src/api/package-api.zod.ts`, which `files[]` ships
via `src/**/*.zod.ts`; positive control `Filter by enabled state` reads 8. So `skip-changeset`
does not apply.

## Acceptance notes — ⛔ not fixed here

1. **Two unreleased changesets still carry the two-filter enumeration**, and both publish into
   `@objectstack/spec` / `@objectstack/runtime` 17.5.0 — the same release this repair ships in.
   `.changeset/17667-packages-query-contract.md:14` (*the serving door filters on `status` /
   `type` and then returns every remaining row*) and
   `.changeset/scoped-packages-dispatcher-door.md:13` (*this door applies its `status` /
   `type` filters and returns every remaining row*). Both are outside this card's declared file
   surface (`packages/spec/src/migrations/`, `packages/spec/src/api/`), so they are reported
   rather than widened into. ⚠️ This has a **deadline**: the release that consumes a changeset
   deletes it and publishes the sentence, after which a factual error is amendable only by a
   dedicated docs-only PR against the released `CHANGELOG.md` entry. Cheapest moment to repair
   them is before that release.

2. **`ListInstalledPackagesResponseSchema.nextCursor` is still declared and never emitted.**
   Recorded as an observation only: the retirement deliberately left the response half alone,
   and the `hasMore` comment argues why. Named here so the next reader of this declaration does
   not mistake it for something this card left half-done.
